title: 策略师谢毅哲：人民币仅小幅升值，出口支撑K型复苏
speaker: Unnamed Guest

segments.en: The Chinese currency has been solid though. Can we expect further appreciation or are things going to slow down from here?
segments.zh: 人民币一直很坚挺。我们能预期进一步升值吗？还是从这开始放缓？

segments.en: I think Chinese government doesn't want to see too much of a strengthening of its currency. So it's quite managed.
segments.zh: 我认为中国政府不希望看到本币过度升值。所以管控很严。

segments.en: So what we expect maybe another one or two percent sort of strengthening of the CNY versus USD but not too much. And plus of course the reason is the export have been very strong.
segments.zh: 所以我们预期人民币兑美元可能再升值1%到2%，但不会太多。当然原因之一是出口非常强劲。

segments.en: And that actually support the K-Shake development consumption was really weak export sector relating sectors were very strong.
segments.zh: 这实际上支撑了K型发展，消费很弱，但出口相关行业非常强劲。
